class="eut-element eut-slogan eut-align-left" style="margin-bottom: 0px;"><div class="eut-subtitle">FROM 45€/Night</div><h2 class="eut-slogan-title eut-align-left eut-title-no-line"><span>Kite Hostel In Tarifa</span></h2>  <p class="">Located in the old town of Tarifa, between &#8220;Puerta Jerez&#8221; and the Theatre. The kite hostel offers private rooms with bathroom and a shared kitchen plus a rooftop apartment.</p></div><div class="eut-element eut-hr " style="padding-top: 20px;padding-bottom: 0px;"><div class="eut-line-divider"></div></div><div class="eut-element eut-text wellbeing_programme vc_custom_1674259070013"><p>The Hostal Africa in Tarifa, is 6 km (10min by car) from Los Lances beach, 12 km from Valdevaqueros beach (15min), the 2 main kite spots.
